weather_report:
Subiaco settles into a damp, blue-tinged night. Clouds have moved in and a light rain is due to brush the suburbs around late evening and whisper on into the small hours, softening streetlights and smudging the edges of the horizon. There will be no sun to speak of overnight; the UV index is effectively nil now and likely to stay low at first light if the overcast lingers. Expect a muted, silvery start rather than a bright one, with the day’s clarity subdued by passing showers and a thin, pearly sky.

Dress for calm, persistent drizzle: a light waterproof, closed shoes that don’t mind puddles, and an umbrella you don’t have to wrestle with the wind. It’s a night for small comforts and unhurried errands—tidying a corner of the house, prepping tomorrow’s breakfast, or a quiet walk beneath awnings to feel the cool air without the soak. If you’re up late, put on a record or a gentle film and let the rain set the tempo; if you’re turning in, lay out tomorrow’s layers and plan on an easy, low-glare morning.
